messages.content: I had a low BS at 2 in the morning - was 68. Should I be worried?
That's something our nurse needs to look at. Let me escalate you now.
Ok. It's up to normal now though. Is it still urgent?
Night lows are clinical - I can't tell you if it's safe to wait on. But your nurse will review what happened and your meds.
Our median is 31 hours. I'm marking it urgent though. You're pt-1005, in the system now.
What if the same thing happens tonight?
If you can't stay awake or feel confused - that's 911. Otherwise grab some carbs and recheck in 15 min. Definitely share all this with the nurse.
You're welcome. Nurse will have your info and will call with an actual plan for overnight.

theme: urgent symptom (chest tightness, very high BP with headache, low glucose at night) escalated
